item_identification.item: Zhonya's Hourglass (id 3157) — or its Time Stop-bearing component Seeker's Armguard (id 2420); both carry the identical active
item_identification.basis: The old golden value is a captured engine output that names 'Time Stop'. Only two cached items declare that active: data/item-atoms/3157.json and data/item-atoms/2420.json.
item_identification.caveat: If the new run's item_coverage[1] is a different item (list membership/order shifted), the two strings are not comparing the same item and the leaf diff is not apples-to-apples; the sibling item-name leaf under item_coverage[1] settles that. The analysis below holds for either Time Stop item.

step_1_declared_families_are_not_all_def.claim_under_test: 'Every declared family on this item is a defence.'
step_1_declared_families_are_not_all_def.cached_declaration_A: data/item-atoms/3157.json declares four atoms across three families: stats (abilityPower flat 105.0), stats (armor flat 50.0), crowd-control-mobility (behavior 'Time Stop', stasis), damage (atom_id 'damage.resistance-mitigation', behavior 'Time Stop', relations to damage.damage-instance / damage.armor-penetration / damage.magic-penetration).
step_1_declared_families_are_not_all_def.cached_declaration_B: data/atoms/items.json objects['Zhonya's Hourglass'] declares atom_ids: control.stasis, damage.basic_attack, economy.total, stat.ability_power (105.0 flat), stat.armor (50.0 flat).
step_1_declared_families_are_not_all_def.result: FALSE. A 'damage' family is literally declared in both decompositions, and stat.ability_power (105 AP) is an offence stat, not a defence. No cached taxonomy even contains a 'defence' family — data/atoms/classification-report.json lists the vocabulary as crowd-control-mobility, damage, heal-shield, interaction, stack-transform-summon-resource, vision-economy (plus stats).

step_2_the_item_does_change_outgoing_TDD.claim_under_test: 'the represented mechanic changes durability, not outgoing TDD'
step_2_the_item_does_change_outgoing_TDD.inputs: data/champions.json Syndra Q 'Dark Sphere' Magic Damage leveling = [90,125,160,195,230] + [70% AP]; cooldown modifiers = [7,7,7,7,7] flat, affectedByCdr false. Zhonya's abilityPower flat = 105.0 (data/items.json id 3157).
step_2_the_item_does_change_outgoing_TDD.arithmetic: AP term per Q cast = 0.70 x 105 = 73.5 magic damage. Over the scenario's 120 s window at base 7 s cooldown, casts = 1 + floor(120/7) = 18, so the item's AP alone adds 73.5 x 18 = 1323 raw magic damage on Q before mitigation (mitigation per math-foundations Section 2: actual = raw x 100/(100+R), a strictly positive multiplier, so the increase survives mitigation).
step_2_the_item_does_change_outgoing_TDD.result: FALSE. The item's outgoing-damage contribution is large and first-order.

step_3_time_stop_itself_also_costs_outgo.cached_wiki_text: data/items.json id 3157 active[0].branches[0]: 'Put yourself in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, rendering you {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|invulnerable}} for the duration but also unable to move, declare [[basic attack]]s, cast [[champion ability|abilities]], use [[summoner spell]]s, or [[active ability items|activate items]].'
step_3_time_stop_itself_also_costs_outgo.formula_quoted: docs/math-foundations.md Section 1.1: 'N(T) = floor(AS . u . T)  (damage.py: num_auto_attacks = floor(...))' with 'u' the auto-attack uptime fraction, and casts scheduled on one shared timeline where 'an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress'.
step_3_time_stop_itself_also_costs_outgo.arithmetic: A 2.5 s stasis removes 2.5 s of uptime from the window: autos lost = 2.5 x AS (>= 2.5 x 0.658 = 1.645 swings at Syndra's cached base attackSpeed 0.658, more with bonus AS), Q casts lost = 2.5/7 = 0.357 casts. Both terms are strictly positive.
step_3_time_stop_itself_also_costs_outgo.result: The stasis mechanic is not durability-only: by the cached wiki text it suppresses basic attacks and ability casts, which the engine's own counting function converts directly into lost outgoing damage. The second decomposition even records this as the atom 'damage.basic_attack' sourced to 'active:Time Stop@kw:basic attack'.

step_4_the_old_reason_checks_out.claim_under_test: 'Time Stop is priced only from the explicit bounded active-seconds scenario input; item presence alone never assumes stasis.'
step_4_the_old_reason_checks_out.evidence: In data/items.json id 3157 the effect lives under `active` (not `passives`), unique=true, with cooldown: null and no trigger condition; simpleDescription = 'Activate to become invincible but unable to take actions'. Nothing in the cached source makes stasis a consequence of owning the item — it is a player-initiated activation with a bounded 2.5 s duration per use.
step_4_the_old_reason_checks_out.result: TRUE and fail-closed: the duration is derivable (2.5 s per activation) but the number of activations inside the window is not present in any cached source, so it must come from a declared scenario input. Assuming stasis from item presence would fabricate an input, and (per step 3) that assumption would move outgoing TDD, not just durability. This matches the repo's stated convention that a missing input is withheld, never defaulted (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6).

conclusion: The new value is false on both of its clauses for the Time Stop item: (a) the item's own cached decomposition declares a `damage` family and a 105 AP offence stat, so 'every declared family is a defence' is contradicted by the data; (b) the cached wiki text for Time Stop explicitly forbids basic attacks and ability casts for 2.5 s, so the represented mechanic demonstrably changes outgoing TDD (>= 1.645 autos and 0.357 Q casts forgone per activation at Syndra's cached rates), on top of the AP term worth 73.5 damage per Q (1323 raw magic damage over the 120 s window). The old value is the accurate and correctly fail-closed statement: stasis is an activation with a bounded 2.5 s duration whose occurrence count is absent from every cached source and must therefore come from an explicit scenario input.
